description: This file implements a checklist dialog box in C, including functions for rendering list items, scroll indicators, buttons, and handling user interactions within a terminal UI environment using ncurses-like library functions.

methods.name: print_item
methods.description: Renders a list item in the dialog window, highlighting if selected.

methods.name: print_arrows
methods.description: Displays scroll up/down indicators based on current scroll position.

methods.name: print_buttons
methods.description: Displays 'Select' and 'Help' buttons at the bottom of the dialog.

methods.name: dialog_checklist
methods.description: Main function to display a checklist dialog box, handle user input, and return the selected option.
